acceptance.quality: All completed raw route/output hashes and DRC/lint results identical; no new solve failure, timeout, or memory censoring. Unfinished outputs are censored, never counted as route parity.
acceptance.comparison: Paired frozen current main in this run; no comparison with historical hardware/defaults.
acceptance.additionalInvestigation: Any repeated-median memory increase >5% or outcome disagreement requires follow-up before acceptance; no silent noise waiver.
